title: Magnifying glass with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x="58" y="62" width="14" height="30" rx="6" fill="#ffcc44" transform="rotate(-45 65 77)"/>
  <rect x="60" y="64" width="5" height="26" rx="2.5" fill="#ffe066" transform="rotate(-45 65 77)"/>
  <!-- lens rim -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="40" r="30" fill="#44aaff"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="40" r="30" fill="none" stroke="#88ccff" stroke-width="4"/>
  <!-- lens glass -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="40" r="24" fill="#88ddff"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="40" r="24" fill="none" stroke="#b3e6ff" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- glass shine -->
  <ellipse cx="31" cy="30" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#e6f7ff" transform="rotate(-25 31 30)"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="31" cy="36" r="3.5" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="36" r="3.5" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="34.5" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="34.5" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M30 46 Q40 56 50 46" fill="none" stroke="#1a1a2e" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="25" cy="44" r="3" fill="#ff99bb" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="44" r="3" fill="#ff99bb" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
